newsitem.title: USA: TWA April passenger load factor unchanged.
newsitem.headline: TWA April passenger load factor unchanged.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Wednesday its April total passenger load factor was essentially unchanged versus last year at 66.7 percent.
Year-to-date, the total load factor for scheduled services was up two points at 66.4 percent versus 64.4 percent in 1996.
TWA said revenue passenger miles fell 6.9 percent in April to 1.95 billion from 2.10 billion for the month last year.
Year to date, revenue passenger miles fell four percent to 7.63 billion from 7.94 billion.
Available seat miles fell 6.8 percent both in April and year to date, to 2.93 billion from 3.14 billion and to 11.49 billion from 12.33 billion, respectively.
TWA said both capacity and traffic declined from April 1996 levels because of a planned downsizing of aircraft on some international routes.
